description: Serialization round-trip fixtures. A value that a wrapper serializes and parses again keeps one canonical form. Ordered arrays keep their order, because scale order and grid order carry meaning. Set-like arrays keep their written order by a deliberate strictness rule, so a reordered list hashes differently. An omitted optional field stays absent. The authoring kinds at the end are values that JSON cannot preserve; authoring rejects them with nonportable_value before serialization.

values.note: An ordered scale survives a round trip in its written order.

value.minor: A wording or preference difference with no identified operational consequence.

value.meaningful: A coordination problem causing rework or delay.

value.serious: A conflict affecting an explicit customer commitment or operational requirement.

values.canonical: [{"minor":"A wording or preference difference with no identified operational consequence."},{"meaningful":"A coordination problem causing rework or delay."},{"serious":"A conflict affecting an explicit customer commitment or operational requirement."}]

values.note: Mixed content with non-ASCII text and an astral-plane character.
Numbers round trip through one canonical form.

order_invariance.note: Two spellings of one object give one canonical form.

order_strictness.note: A set-like array in written order. The canonical form uses the written order, so the two orders give two hashes.

absent_stays_absent.note: An omitted optional field stays absent. Canonicalization inserts no value.

rejected_kinds.note: A function is not a JSON value.
A class is not a JSON value.
A regular expression object is not a JSON value.
A Date object is not a JSON value.
A Map object is not a JSON value.
A Set object is not a JSON value.
A bigint is not a JSON number.
undefined as a property value hides an author error. It is not dropped silently.
undefined as an array element is not dropped silently.
NaN is not a JSON number.
Infinity is not a JSON number.
A string with an unpaired surrogate cannot become UTF-8 text.
A symbol property outside the documented TypeBox markers is not portable.
